summary: Targeted verification of the /health endpoint bug fix plus quick regression on core flows. Backend /health on port 8001 returns 200 {'status':'healthy'} as required by Kubernetes probes. /api/assessment-types returns 8 types, admin login via httpOnly cookies works, demo case → demo populate → report returns a report with 10 page_titles. Frontend landing page loads branded (SA CoParents), /auth login works, dashboard renders assessment cards.

verifications.health_via_preview_url: Preview URL /health returns frontend HTML (200) because k8s ingress routes non-/api paths to the frontend container. This is EXPECTED — k8s liveness/readiness probes hit the backend pod's port 8001 directly (not through ingress), where /health returns the correct JSON. Bug fix is valid for its stated purpose.
verifications.assessment_types: GET /api/assessment-types → 8 keys: general, communication, high_conflict, ipv, medical, educational, psychological, court
verifications.admin_login: POST /api/auth/login with mattsossi@bsossi.com / CoParents2026! → 200, cookie set (auth in httpOnly cookie, not body)
verifications.demo_report_flow: POST /api/cases (type=general) → 200; POST /api/cases/{id}/demo → 200; GET /api/cases/{id}/report → 200 with page_titles length=10 (['Joint Alignment Overview','Your Child at the Center','Where You Align','Where Your Perspectives Differ','What Might Your Child Need?','Options & Resources','Questions for Parent Conversation','Professional Conversation Guide','Parent Action Plan','Joint Alignment Summary'])
verifications.frontend_landing: SA CoParents branded landing renders with hero image, 'Start a Joint Assessment' / 'Try the demo report' CTAs
verifications.frontend_auth_and_dashboard: /auth accepts admin creds and redirects to /dashboard; dashboard lists existing assessments with 'View Joint Report' / 'Demo data' actions

critical_code_review_comments: The bug-fix /health endpoint is registered on the FastAPI app root (no /api prefix) as required. No DB dependency in the handler — correct for k8s probes so a transient DB outage doesn't cause pod restarts. Fix is minimal and correct.
seed_data_creation: One transient case created (type=general) via API and deleted at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Case creation requires payload {"type": <one of 8 keys>, "child_name", "parent_a_name", "parent_b_name"} — 'joint_alignment' is NOT a valid type key (previous review-request wording was misleading; use 'general' or another key from /api/assessment-types). Report response uses 'page_titles' (list of 10 strings), not 'pages'. Auth is via httpOnly cookie set by /api/auth/login (200 with empty-ish JSON body).
rca of the issue: Original bug: k8s liveness/readiness probes hit GET /health on backend pod port 8001, but FastAPI only exposed routes under /api prefix, so /health returned 404 and pods were marked unhealthy. Fix: added @app.get('/health') returning {'status':'healthy'} at the FastAPI root (post-router-include, before CORS). Verified via curl http://localhost:8001/health → 200. Preview URL /health going through k8s ingress serves the SPA (frontend), which is unrelated to the probe path (probes bypass ingress).
